dish.title: Turkish İskender Kebab: Sliced Lamb over Pide with Tomato Sauce, Brown Butter, and Yogurt
dish.description: A home version of the Bursa classic: thin slices of seared, marinated lamb laid over cubes of toasted pide, ladled with a warm buttery tomato sauce, finished at the table with sizzling brown butter, and served with cool garlic yogurt and blistered green peppers and tomatoes.

recipe_version.title: Turkish İskender Kebab: Sliced Lamb over Pide with Tomato Sauce, Brown Butter, and Yogurt
recipe_version.description: A home version of the Bursa classic: thin slices of seared, marinated lamb laid over cubes of toasted pide, ladled with a warm buttery tomato sauce, finished at the table with sizzling brown butter, and served with cool garlic yogurt and blistered green peppers and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.preparation: grated, juice squeezed out and kept

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp lamb, 1/2 tsp sauce, 1/4 tsp yogurt

ingredients.name: Turkish pide bread
ingredients.display_name: Turkish pide bread whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, and oil only
ingredients.note: about 1 lb; plain flatbread is the swap

ingredients.name: long green Turkish or Italian frying peppers
ingredients.display_name: long green Turkish or Italian frying peppers

steps.title: Marinate the lamb
steps.body: Slice the very cold lamb thin, 1/8 inch thick. Grate the onion and squeeze its juice over the lamb, discarding the pulp. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, the paprika, cumin, oregano, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper and toss.

steps.title: Marinate while prepping
steps.body: Let the lamb marinate 30 minutes. Meanwhile cube the pide, grate the garlic and stir it into the yogurt with 1/4 tsp salt, and chop the parsley (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce
steps.body: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a 1-quart saucepan over medium, stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the crushed tomatoes, 1/2 cup water, the sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer until slightly thickened, about 8 minutes. Keep warm.

steps.title: Preheat the broiler and toast
steps.body: Preheat the broiler on high for 5 minutes. Spread the pide cubes on one side of a rimmed sheet pan and the peppers and cherry tomatoes, tossed with 1 tbsp olive oil, on the other. Broil until the bread is crisp at the edges and the vegetables blister, about 5 minutes, turning once.

steps.title: Sear the lamb
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over high until smoking. Sear the lamb in three batches in a single layer until browned at the edges, about 1 minute per side.

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.body: Melt 4 tbsp butter in an 8-inch skillet over medium and cook, swirling, until nutty brown and foaming, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.body: Divide the pide cubes among plates, ladle some tomato sauce over them, and lay the lamb on top. Spoon more sauce over the lamb, pour the sizzling brown butter over everything, and add a big spoonful of garlic yogurt, the blistered peppers and tomatoes, and parsley.

Compared with greek-chicken-souvlaki: lamb over sauced bread cubes, not chicken skewers in pita. Compared with persian-lamb-koobideh-saffron-rice in this wave: sliced lamb on bread with butter and yogurt, not ground kebabs over rice. Compared with sabich-pita-sandwiches: a plated meat dish, not a stuffed pita.
